diff --git a/context_ratelimit.go b/context_ratelimit.go
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..8e16d63
--- /dev/null
+++ b/context_ratelimit.go
@@ -0,0 +1,14 @@
+package gin
+
+// RateLimitKey is the context key under which rate limit metadata is stored.
+const RateLimitKey = "_gin-gonic/gin/ratelimit"
+
+// RateLimitRemaining returns the remaining request budget recorded by a rate limiting middleware.
+func (c *Context) RateLimitRemaining() (int, bool) {
+	v, ok := c.Get(RateLimitKey)
+	if !ok {
+		return 0, false
+	}
+	n, ok := v.(int)
+	return n, ok
+}
